id.description: Identifier of the task: the prefix of the project and the number, such as SHOP-1. The event envelope names the task by it.

title.description: Title of the task: one line of up to 80 characters.

state.description: State of the task: active — in work, waiting — waits for the operator, closed — done, cancelled — given up.

scenario.description: Scenario of the task in the flow of the task.

stage.description: Current stage of the task. Its exit, instruction and transitions are given by `gentry stage show`.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree the task holds; absent once the task released it.

flow.description: The commit that applied the flow of the task: the task follows that flow to its end, whatever is applied later.

statement.title: TaskStatement
statement.description: Statement of the task as passed, with its source.

source.description: Who passed the title and the statement: operator — the operator, agent — the agent wrote them from the words of the operator.

taken.description: Time the task was taken in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

scenario.title: TaskScenario
scenario.description: Scenario of the task in the flow of the task.

stage.title: TaskStage
stage.description: Current stage of the task. Its exit, instruction and transitions are given by `gentry stage show`.

node.description: Node of the scenario the task is at.

id.description: Identifier of the stage of the node.
